wa: Hello Valorin, I saw your video on customer master data for e-invoicing and would like to check our invoice data.
linkedin:
Each e-invoice usually pulls the buyer's details from your ERP customer master. If that record is incomplete, the invoice is too.

Under Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, Art. 5(1)(a), as amended by Ministerial Resolution No. 66 of 2026, in-scope businesses with revenue of AED 50m or more implement e-invoicing by 1 January 2027 (UAE Ministry of Finance).

In our view, three checks belong on this month's list:
• A TRN on every VAT-registered business customer
• Legal names as registered, not short names
• One owner who approves new customer records

Who in your team owns the customer master today?
